description: Source code for map sensor decoding and processing in engine control firmware, including pressure sensor calibration, validation, and data acquisition functions.

methods.name: decodePressure
methods.description: Decodes voltage to pressure in kPa based on sensor configuration.

methods.name: validateMap
methods.description: Checks if MAP sensor value is within expected range.

methods.name: validateBaroMap
methods.description: Checks if Baro/MAP sensor value is within expected range.

methods.name: getMapByVoltage
methods.description: Returns manifold absolute pressure in kPa from voltage reading.

methods.name: getRawMap
methods.description: Retrieves current MAP sensor reading, possibly with frequency reporting.

methods.name: hasBaroSensor
methods.description: Determines if a Baro sensor is present or fixed MAP value is used.

methods.name: hasMapSensor
methods.description: Checks if MAP sensor hardware channel is configured.

methods.name: getBaroPressure
methods.description: Returns the current Baro pressure, possibly fixed from initial reading.

methods.name: getDecoder
methods.description: Returns pointer to the appropriate pressure sensor decoder based on sensor type.

methods.name: applyConfiguration
methods.description: Initializes sensor decoders and configuration parameters.

methods.name: digitalMapWidthCallback
methods.description: Callback to update map frequency based on digital input width.

methods.name: printMAPInfo
methods.description: Outputs current MAP sensor info and status messages.

methods.name: initMapDecoder
methods.description: Initializes MAP decoder and configuration, including fixed baro pressure if enabled.
